definition{
  name: breaksStartInBounds,
  parameters: [],
  result: Bool,
  body: (not (((project (DinnerSeats::initial) booked) <=? 12) && ((project (DinnerSeats::initial) list) <? 2)))
}

theorem{
  name: startInBounds,
  parameters: [],
  statement: ((breaksStartInBounds) = false),
  proof: linear_arithmetic{
    definitions: [
      DinnerSeats::answerBooked,
      DinnerSeats::answerCancelled,
      DinnerSeats::answerClosed,
      DinnerSeats::answerFull,
      DinnerSeats::answerNothing,
      DinnerSeats::initial,
      DinnerSeats::listClosed,
      DinnerSeats::listOpen,
      breaksStartInBounds
    ]
  },
  axioms: [Classical.choice, Quot.sound, propext]
}

}
